flaps._comment: 747-8 profile uses Boeing 747-family detent labels. Working Title 747 tutorial material explicitly uses takeoff flaps 10, approach flaps 20, and landing flaps 25/30; flaps 1/5 are retained as standard intermediate 747 detents but need in-sim percent verification.

grades._comment: Conservative heavy-aircraft bands for the included 747-8. Keep partial until manual/in-sim landing thresholds are confirmed.

aircraftCfg._comment: High-confidence fallback requires the exact B748 type, a flyable/user-selectable config, first-party creator evidence, and a 747-8i/-8F product field. This excludes passive and traffic-only B748 models.

lvars._comment: This profile uses an explicit standard-SimVar monitoring allowlist; no Microsoft/Asobo/Working Title-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

controls._comment: Only standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed. The Working Title tutorial warns against a simple autopilot-master toggle for Boeing behavior, so autopilot writes remain unavailable until profile-specific engage/disconnect actions are verified.

meta.notes: First-party Boeing 747-8 profile published by Microsoft and developed by Asobo Studio. It covers the MSFS 2024 passenger 747-8i and freighter 747-8F; MSFS 2020 included the 747-8i. Working Title supplies the documented avionics and is credited for the manuals. The exact trusted adapter exposes four-engine standard-SimVar monitoring only; custom telemetry and aircraft-specific writes remain inactive.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists Boeing 747-8i (-8F) as included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard, Deluxe, Premium Deluxe, and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: Uses the official heading Boeing 747-8i & 8f and credits the manuals to Working Title. It does not identify Working Title as the base-aircraft vendor or publish an external telemetry/control variable map.

sources.name: Boeing 747-8i / -8F Tutorial Flight - Instructions and Reference
sources.notes: Official MSFS 2024 manual identifies both the passenger 747-8i and freighter 747-8F, gives ICAO B748, and warns that Boeing autopilot requires separate ON/OFF commands rather than a generic master toggle.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - Key Events
sources.notes: Documents key events as simulator control bindings. This profile does not add custom key-event mappings; it only permits Flight Fabric's narrow standard gear/flaps fallback.

knownIssues: Package and SimObject matching uses documented product identifiers; stock 747-8i and 747-8F runtime titles still need in-sim verification.
Flap detent labels are source-backed, but their runtime handle-index order needs in-sim verification.
The cited Microsoft, Asobo, and Working Title sources do not define a 747-8 LVAR, B-var, or input-event integration map.

The cited sources do not define an external control contract, so aircraft-specific writes remain blocked; the official manual's separate autopilot ON/OFF requirement also rules out generic autopilot-master fallback.
